summary.text: J.B. Akers is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 55, to which he was appointed in January 2024, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney and business owner.

paragraphs.text: J.B. Akers was born in Beckley, West Virginia, and graduated from Milton High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Wake Forest University in 1995 and a law degree from the West Virginia University College of Law in 1999.
Before his appointment, he was the owner and managing attorney at Akers Law Offices, PLLC.
Akers was appointed to the House of Delegates to replace Republican Moore Capito, assumed office on January 9, 2024, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
